summary: Ten sub-orders in demo/web, one per thing the order asks, the command line's changes one after the other.
assumptions: A pantry file stays a JSON list of items.

subOrders.title: Remind of the items best before soon

size.mechanism: expiringSoon in pantry.mjs and the remind command

subOrders.doneWhen: test/pantry.test.mjs shows expiringSoon's items soonest first, a past item included and a later one left out, and remind prints them as list does
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Refuse a pantry file with an invalid best-before date

size.mechanism: a check of each item in load

subOrders.doneWhen: test/store.test.mjs shows load throwing an error that names an item dated 'soon'
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Flag an item added with a date already past

size.mechanism: the grace rule in addItem, and the mark in list

subOrders.doneWhen: test/pantry.test.mjs shows addItem marking an item past the grace rule with flagged: true, and leaving a later one unmarked
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Run a command for each item best before soon

size.mechanism: one shell command per item: the given command line with the item's name appended

subOrders.doneWhen: test/notify.test.mjs shows, through an injected exec, the command line built for each item expiringSoon returns
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Print the pantry's statistics in six formats

size.mechanism: three reports, each rendered in six formats

subOrders.doneWhen: test/stats.test.mjs shows the three reports of a fixed list of items in each of the six formats
subOrders.why: code with tests, which nip builds test-first

subOrders.title: Remove an item by its name

size.mechanism: removeItem in pantry.mjs and the remove command

subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Rename an item

size.mechanism: renameItem in pantry.mjs and the rename command

subOrders.doneWhen: test/pantry.test.mjs shows renameItem changing one item's name and no other's, and rename saving the list
subOrders.why: a small change, quick to write and to read

subOrders.title: Keep the text save replaces in a backup file
subOrders.doneWhen: test/store.test.mjs shows save over an existing file leaving its old text in <file>.bak
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Leave the pantry file whole when a save fails

size.mechanism: a write to a file beside it, then a rename, in save

subOrders.doneWhen: test/store.test.mjs shows a save whose write fails leaving the pantry file's text as it was
subOrders.why: a small change to code, with a test first

subOrders.title: Say how to use the new commands in the README
subOrders.doneWhen: README.md shows the command line of remind, notify, stats, remove and rename
subOrders.why: a page of prose and no code

considered.cut: all the commands in one sub-order
considered.whyNot: a person could not review it as one change

alternatives.whyThis: one sub-order per thing the order asks, so each merges on its own
